Class Connector

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.network.socket.server.Connector
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, Runnable
public final class Connector extends Object implements VirtualView, Runnable
Per-client connection handler on the server side. Implements VirtualView to ship server callbacks to the client and Runnable to consume requests off the client socket on a dedicated thread.

Outbound messages are dispatched through a single-threaded executor so a slow or stuck client does not block the controller (which would otherwise keep its lock held during the broadcast and freeze the whole match).
